dengue.label: Dengue and mosquitoes
dengue.step1: Empty standing water once a week: buckets, pots, coolers, old tyres and flower vases.
dengue.step2: Sleep under a mosquito net, and cover arms and legs in the evening.
dengue.step3: Fever with body pain? See a doctor early. Do not take aspirin or ibuprofen on your own.

flood.label: Heavy rain and floods
flood.step1: Never walk or drive through flowing water. Even knee-deep water can sweep you away.
flood.step2: Keep away from drains, open manholes and fallen electric wires.
flood.step3: Keep your phone charged and follow official warnings. If you are in danger, call 112.

heat.label: Heat
heat.step1: Drink water often, even when you are not thirsty.
heat.step2: Stay out of the sun in the hottest hours, from about noon to 4 pm.
heat.step3: Check on old people, small children and anyone who works outside.

cyber.label: Online fraud
cyber.step1: Never share an OTP, PIN or password, not even with someone who says they are from the bank or the police.
cyber.step2: The police never arrest anyone on a video call. Hang up.
cyber.step3: Lost money? Call 1930 at once, or report it at cybercrime.gov.in.

water.label: Water
water.step1: Fix dripping taps, and turn the tap off while you brush.
water.step2: Report broken pipes and leaks to your water board or local body.
water.step3: Collect rainwater from your roof if you can.

air.label: Air pollution
air.step1: Do not burn rubbish, dry leaves or crop stubble.
air.step2: Walk, cycle or take the bus for short trips when you can.
air.step3: On smoggy days, keep children and old people indoors.

waste.label: Garbage and drains
waste.step1: Keep wet and dry waste apart, and give it to the garbage van.
waste.step2: Do not throw plastic into drains. Blocked drains cause floods and mosquitoes.
waste.step3: Report garbage dumps and overflowing drains to your local body.

roads.label: Roads and potholes
roads.step1: Note the place (a landmark helps) and take a photo.
roads.step2: Report it to your city corporation, town council or gram panchayat.
roads.step3: Ask for the complaint number, and follow up if nothing happens.

traffic.label: Road accidents
traffic.step1: Wear a helmet on a two-wheeler and a seat belt in a car, every time.
traffic.step2: Never drive after drinking, and do not use your phone while driving.
traffic.step3: Saw an accident? Call 112 or 108. The law protects people who help (Good Samaritan rules).

power.label: Power cuts
power.step1: Report power cuts and sparking wires to your electricity company.
power.step2: Stay away from fallen wires and wet electric poles.
power.step3: Switch off lights and fans that nobody is using.

farming.label: Farming
farming.step1: Do not burn crop stubble. Mix it into the soil or give it for fodder.
farming.step2: Get your soil tested at the nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra or agriculture office.
farming.step3: Buy seeds and fertiliser only from licensed shops, and keep the bill.

health.label: Health
health.step1: Keep your children's vaccinations up to date.
health.step2: Drink clean, boiled or filtered water, and wash your hands before eating.
health.step3: In a medical emergency, call 108 for an ambulance.

elections.label: Elections
elections.step1: Check that your name is on the voter list.
elections.step2: Turned 18? Register with Form 6 on the Voters' Service Portal.
elections.step3: On voting day, go and vote, and help older neighbours reach the booth.

schemes.label: Government schemes
schemes.action: Get the schemes you are owed
schemes.step1: See which schemes you can get on the Schemes page.
schemes.step2: Apply only through official offices and websites.
schemes.step3: Never pay a middleman, and ask for a receipt for every fee.

schools.label: Schools and exams
schools.step1: Make sure every child aged 6 to 14 goes to school. It is free, and it is their right.
schools.step2: Go to school meetings for parents and ask questions.
schools.step3: Check exam dates and results only on official websites.

safety.label: Crime and safety
safety.step2: Know your nearest police station and its phone number.
safety.step3: Report crimes. You can get a copy of the FIR, and it is free.

civic.label: How your district is run
civic.step1: Go to your Gram Sabha or ward meeting and speak up.
civic.step2: Use RTI to ask the government for information.
civic.step3: Report anyone who asks for a bribe to the anti-corruption office or the Lokayukta.
